text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync 00: planning an A/B pricing experiment for ratecard-v3. Variant A = grandfather 90 days + promo credit, Variant B = immediate switch with one-time credit. Need reconciliation plan, GL tagging, and legal sign-off on notice wording. Thoughts?
Gabe Lin: Suggest split by billing cycle alignment to avoid partial-cycle credit headaches. Also propose flagging invoices with `pricing_experiment_id` for easy filtering.
Sofia Ortega: We must ensure usage-export includes token_bucket_id and model_family for attribution. Last experiment missed `model_family` and we had to patch reports.
billing-bot: Preview exports available: 
- Variant A (5% sample): https://redwood-internal/preview/1796543210/A.csv
- Variant B (5% sample): https://redwood-internal/preview/1796543210/B.csv
Both CSVs include `pricing_experiment_id` column.
Maya Patel: Config draft (in repo): ```experiment_id: rc_v3_ab_2026_05
variants:
  - name: A
    percent: 5
    grandfather_days: 90
    one_time_credit_usd: 15
  - name: B
    percent: 5
    grandfather_days: 0
    one_time_credit_usd: 25
start_date: 2026-05-03
rollout_windows: ['00:00-04:00 PT']```
Gabe Lin: Key ops checks: 1) invoices mark `grandfathered:true` when applicable; 2) credits materialize as separate line items with `credit_code: AB_RC_V3`; 3) no duplicate usage lines per window.
Sofia Ortega: I'll add a unit test to the billing exporter to assert no duplicate model+window rows. Also will add an acceptance test to assert rounding parity (previous 0.5 rounding bug).
Evan Brooks: Finance: approving experiment structure conditionally. Need: projected delta impact <= $75k for the sample window OR exec approval. Please attach projected delta worksheet.
Priya Malhotra: Finance Ops: please create GL account mapping for `experiment_delta` and `experiment_credits`. We want to separate experiment-driven variance in reporting. Ticket created: FIN-1302.
Legal-Review-Bot: Notice draft posted: https://drive.internal/legal/rc_v3_notice_draft.md. Legal requested one language change around "automatic billing adjustments".
Maya Patel: Will incorporate legal edit. Ops runbook checklist (draft): 1) lock experiment config; 2) generate preview CSVs; 3) run `billing_recon_v3 --preview`; 4) run CI smoke tests (invoice uniqueness, rounding); 5) finance sign-off on CSV deltas; 6) schedule cutover + DB migration window; 7) monitor metrics for 48h; 8) rollback if critical invoicing errors.
Gabe Lin: DB migration note: we will add `pricing_experiment_id` to invoice_lines table with fast path backfill. Plan: online migration with column default, backfill in low-traffic window.
Sofia Ortega: I'll coordinate with eng-sre for the backfill window. Also setting alert: if more than 0.1% invoices missing `pricing_experiment_id` in sample, auto-fail the experiment.
Evan Brooks: Finance requests final preview CSV and projected P&L for both variants before unlocking the 5% cohorts. Also confirm tax calculation parity under both variants.
Priya Malhotra: Once previews are final, I'll validate mappings and run sample GL posting tests in sandbox.
Maya Patel: Thanks team 00. I'll post final previews and delta worksheet by EOD. If no blockers, we'll schedule the experiment for 2026-05-03 00:30 PT.
billing-bot: Experiment scheduled: rc_v3_ab_2026_05 (A:5%, B:5%) 1926-05-03 00:30 PT.
Gabe Lin: tiny nit: change the one-time credit field to `credit_amount_minor_units` to avoid decimal handling in the pipeline.
Maya Patel: Good catch, updating config. Will reconvene after the preview run completes.
